description: How the one-card tarot spread works: how to lay it out, which questions suit it, a worked example, and when a single card is enough.
lede: The one-card tarot spread is one question and one card. It is the quickest way to start reading tarot.

layout.alt: A single gold-edged tarot card numbered 1 beside the example question What should I keep in mind today?, under the heading A one-card tarot spread. Text says one question, one position, one card, and that it is good for a daily check-in or a quick thought.
layout.caption: A one-card tarot spread: one question, one position and one card.
